summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco Russell 2000 Dynamic Multifactor ETF (OMFS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund tracks an index of US small-cap stocks selected by five investment factors, which are weighted based on current macroeconomic conditions. OMFS was launched on Nov 8, 2017 and is issued by Invesco.

holdings.infoBox: OMFS is an equity ETF with a total of 1110 individual holdings. The top holdings are CareTrust REIT stock at 1.67%, FirstCash Holdings at 1.58%, SSR Mining at 1.44%, Terreno Realty at 1.19%, and Brinker International at 1.15%.
